hook: Mot chiec khen bi lac vao khu rung phat sang
conflict: Chiec khen bi mat am thanh khi chaym vao mot bong hoa bi an, phai tim lai giong cua minh
premise: Be An va chiec khen than ky cung nhau di qua nhung vung dat ky dieu de tim lai am thanh cho khen
differentiation: Khen khong phai la nhan vat chinh ma la nguoi ban dong hanh, am thanh cua khen tao ra phep mau
payoff: Khi khen tim lai am thanh, no phat ra nhac dieu lam cho ca khu rung noi hoa, be An hieu ra am thanh cua chinh minh cung quy gia
lesson: Khong can giong noi that to, chi can su chan thanh va yeu thuong
visual_potential: Khu rung voi hoa phat sang, lung linh, nhung sinh vat be nhu tho con, chim hot, khen bay lung tung toa ra am thanh mau sac
